en-US.title: Rally AI - Multi-Human Reactive Artifacts
en-US.subtitle: Your canvases, close at hand
en-US.description:
Keep the things you make with Rally close at hand. Open a shared list, check a plan, or use a tool your team built together.

Your canvases open straight to the finished work. Pin the ones you use most to the tab bar, and arrange them in the sidebar. When something needs changing, open the conversation and tell Rally what you need.

Start a new canvas from your phone, add photos and files, and pick up work you started on your computer. Everyone with access sees the same canvas.

Rally works with your Rally account and organization. An internet connection is required.
en-US.promoText: Open your canvases, keep your favorites a tap away, and make changes in the conversation.
